title: 2 men injured in late-night shooting in Dorchester, police say
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Two men were injured in a shooting at 31 Hancock St., Dorchester on Friday evening, police reported.
Both victims sustained non-life-threatening injuries and sought treatment at local hospitals, officials confirmed.
No suspect has been identified, and police are continuing their investigation into the incident.

title: Woman trapped, injured in second incident on MBTA Davis escalator this year
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: A woman was injured on an MBTA Davis Station escalator when her clothing got trapped in the mechanism.
A fellow rider stopped the escalator and helped free the woman; she was hospitalized for a hand injury.
Earlier this year, a similar incident at Davis Station resulted in a man's death due to escalator entrapment.

title: 2 men arrested after allegedly stealing chain, wallet at knifepoint in Dorchester
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Deivi Yoander Sanchez Aguasvivas and Luis Miguel Ramirez-Astacio arrested for alleged knifepoint robbery in Dorchester.
Victim reported being robbed of chain and wallet by men on a blue moped near 140 Humboldt Ave.
Aguasvivas arraigned and held without bail; Ramirez-Astacio has multiple outstanding warrants for robbery and assault.

title: It’s not too late to submit your idea for $2 million in Boston spending
author: Morgan Rousseau
bullets: Boston extends deadline to Aug. 7 for $2 million participatory budgeting submissions.
Residents can propose projects needing one-time investments via Boston's participatory budgeting website.
Final project proposals will be selected post-review and voted on from Jan. 15 to Feb. 15.

title: Watch: Ceddanne Rafaela hits home runs in back-to-back at-bats
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Ceddanne Rafaela hit back-to-back home runs against the Dodgers in his first two at-bats on Saturday.
Rafaela's first home run was a 389-foot shot off Yoshinobu Yamamoto in the top of the first inning.
The second home run tied the game in the third inning with a 402-foot shot, again against Yamamoto.

title: Red Sox reportedly attempted to acquire shortstop Elly De La Cruz, turned down by Reds
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: The Red Sox attempted to trade for Reds shortstop Elly De La Cruz but were unable to agree on terms.
Boston's offer for De La Cruz was primarily prospect-based, as they seek to boost their middle infield strength.
Despite acquiring injured Curtis Mead, the Red Sox explore options for upgrades before the trade deadline.

title: Drake Maye says his shoulder ‘feels great’ as Patriots training camp continues
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Drake Maye reports his shoulder feels great as Patriots' training camp continues in Foxborough.
Patriots added wide receiver A.J. Brown, enhancing their offensive lineup after Super Bowl loss.
New England prepares for a Super Bowl LX rematch against the Seattle Seahawks in Week 1.

title: If July’s stretch of dominance wasn’t enough, the Red Sox’ win Friday proved they’re plenty capable of a postseason run
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Boston Red Sox defeated the Los Angeles Dodgers 5-4 on Friday, demonstrating their postseason potential.
Ceddanne Rafaela led the offense, reversing a 4-3 deficit with crucial plays, underscoring the team's depth.
The victory showcases Boston's strong form ahead of the trade deadline despite missing key players.

title: Red Sox fend off Dodgers, 9-4, in grindy series opener
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: The Boston Red Sox defeated the Los Angeles Dodgers 9-4 in a series opener at Dodger Stadium.
Ceddanne Rafaela hit a two-run home run in the seventh, highlighting the Red Sox late-game comeback.
Brayan Bello pitched four scoreless innings in relief, helping Boston maintain their lead over the Dodgers.

title: Gabe Jacas makes his Patriots debut and other takeaways from Day 7 of training camp
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Patriots' defense recorded two interceptions during Saturday's training camp, testing quarterback Drake Maye's skills.
Gabe Jacas, Patriots' 2026 second-round pick, made a limited debut at practice after a knee procedure.
Undrafted rookie Tanner Arkin impressed at tight end, potentially earning a role as a run-game blocker.
